assumptions: Each insert already carries terminal homology with the arcs on both sides of its gap.
The digest is complete: every site of every named enzyme is cut.
limits: Predicts the constructs, not their yield.
One insert per gap; a gap taking two fragments is an ordinary multi-fragment assembly.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which construct does this backbone, opened at several sites, make with these inserts placed at once?

description: Open ONE circular backbone at several places and place several inserts in a single step. A complete digest at n sites leaves n arcs and n gaps between them, and every gap has to be filled for the ring to close; the arcs and the inserts go to the same homology assembler the single-insert tool uses, and which insert lands in which gap is read off each construct the homology graph closes rather than guessed. It designs no homology arm: an insert arrives with the ends it has, and a set whose ends do not meet the arcs is the assembler's own refusal.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

backbone.description: the circular vector to open. Leave unset to use the open record.

enzymes.description: the enzymes that open the backbone, by name (1409 in the cloning catalogue). Their sites ARE the insertion points, so two single-cutters give two of them; a name the catalogue does not carry is refused by name rather than ignored.

inserts.description: the fragments to place, one per insertion point — wire upstream `record` outputs here, or name library documents.

max_constructs.description: cap on how many distinct constructs are enumerated. Advanced.

max_homology_bp.description: longest terminal homology considered; the bound is EXCLUSIVE, as upstream's own range is. In bp.

min_homology_bp.description: minimum terminal homology for two ends to join. In bp.

name: assemble_multiple_inserts

arcs.description: the backbone's arcs: their lengths and the enzyme that made each end — the insertion points, made readable

cutCounts.description: sites found per enzyme, so an enzyme that does not cut is named rather than silently absent

insertionPoints.description: how many gaps the digest left, which is how many inserts the step takes

placements.description: every construct the ring closes on, each with the inserts in the order they sit around it

reading.description: what was planned, generated from the enumeration rather than the request

record.description: the first construct, as a record
